CCTV is undoubtedly a useful tool. Its utility whether in homes, offices, malls, or public spaces goes without saying. But can a CCTV camera be positioned in a way that infringes upon someone’s privacy? Can it be installed so that it peers into a neighbor’s home? In theory, no—and now, in the eyes of the law, the answer is also no. The Allahabad High Court recently stated that no individual may install a private CCTV camera in a manner that encroaches upon a neighbor’s privacy.
